migration: govern-process-adoption-proposals: Release and self-adopt this capability before a separately reviewed consumer opt-in or Renovate operations activation. Install the managed PyYAML 6.0.3 runtime dependency rather than a custom YAML scanner. Consumers choosing schema 3 must pin an immutable protected-base verifier and producer repository; independently supply a clean tagged producer checkout, release artifacts, receipt, and attestation; require exact target synchronization; keep automerge false and consumerOwnerMergeRequired true; manually merge the reviewed PR as the terminal cutover; and run no post-merge synchronization. Existing schema-1/schema-2 dependency proposal and agent-host completed-publication routes retain their released behavior.

provenance.statement: The public N-1 lifecycle receipt and reviewed Release PR authorize this release.

changes.rationale: Add a first-class Renovate process-adoption proposal whose complete candidate is protected-base verified and permanently consumer-owner-merge-only, while preserving standing auto-merge for agent-host PRs created after lifecycle completion and retaining automation-proposal schemas 1 and 2 unchanged.
